description: This file is a configuration and utility module for Axios HTTP client used in a React frontend project. It handles API URL resolution, token management, request/response interceptors, and environment-specific URL normalization.

methods.name: resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL considering environment variables and environment context (local, preview, etc.).

methods.name: getResolvedApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the resolved API base URL used in Axios configuration.

methods.name: getOpenApiDocsUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL for the OpenAPI documentation endpoint.
